subject: CloudBridge co-sell readiness: SKU mapping, billing cert, and technical evidence
messages:
From: Ethan Zhou <ethan@cloudbridge.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Co-sell kickoff: SKU mapping + billing cert needs

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for agreeing to co-sell with CloudBridge. We did a quick pass on the SKU mapping and put together the initial workbook (attached) and a short list of items that the marketplaces need from Redwood to complete the listing and co-sell enablement. High level:

- AWS: need seller account evidence, ASIN/SKU mapping, metering contract (if metered)
- Azure: co-sell certification questionnaire + joint solution brief
- GCP: listing metadata + partner verified badge checklist

Questions for you:
1) Can you confirm Redwood's AWS Seller ID and the exact product names you want displayed?
2) Do you have an existing metering integration for usage-based billing or will this be SKU/subscription only?
3) Who from your side can provide the security/compliance evidence for AWS/Azure (SOC2 summary + data flow diagram)?

We propose the following timeline if feasible:
- 2/21: finalize SKU mapping and seller IDs
- 2/24: submit AWS seller portal evidence
- 3/1: Azure co-sell certification submission

Attached: co-sell-sku-mapping.xlsx (draft)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Ethan
Ethan Zhou
Partner Lead, CloudBridge
https://cloudbridge.io

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Zhou <ethan@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-20T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell kickoff: SKU mapping + billing cert needs

Ethan —

Appreciate the clear breakdown. Quick answers inline below and next steps at the bottom.

1) AWS Seller ID: 1234-REDWOOD-SELLER (see attached evidence PDF). Product display name: "Redwood Inference API - Hosted" and "Redwood Inference - Dedicated" (we'll canonicalize display names in the sheet).
2) Metering: for Hosted API we do per-token metered billing via our billing service; Dedicated is subscription. We have an AWS usage-reporting webhook that can emit daily usage CSVs — Ben can provide the integration spec.
3) Compliance evidence: Marissa will own SOC2 + data flow diagrams; she has the SOC2 summary and can produce a redacted architecture diagram for submission.

Ben / Vanessa — please see action items:
- Ben: confirm the metering webhook endpoint and gap list for Azure metering (if any).
- Vanessa: draft the joint solution brief and start the Azure co-sell questionnaire (I can introduce you to Azure ops).
- Marissa: I'll need the SOC2 summary and a redacted diagram by 2/23.

Ethan — attaching our seller evidence PDF and updated SKU mapping (I copied a couple display names). If the timeline below works for you we will treat this as our internal target:
- 2/21: finalize SKU naming + Ben to confirm metering integration notes
- 2/23: Marissa uploads SOC2 + diagram
- 2/24: we submit to AWS portal

If you want a short sync I can carve 30 minutes tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Zhou <ethan@cloudbridge.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-21T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell kickoff: SKU mapping + billing cert needs

Folks — quick technical update on metering and a short list of gaps I see for marketplace readiness.

What we have (ready):
- AWS Seller ID confirmed and proof attached (redwood-aws-seller-evidence.pdf)
- Hosted API metering: webhook endpoint (POST /metering/usage) that emits daily usage CSVs with customer_id and token_count.
- Billing mapping: Hosted = metered, Dedicated = subscription/SKU.

Gaps / actions required:
- Azure metering: Azure requires either marketplace metering SDK or usage callbacks; we currently do not have an Azure-compatible SDK. ETA to deliver a lightweight callback adapter: 3 weeks (target 3/13).
- Joint solution brief: need partner logo usage signoff from marketing (Vanessa to coordinate).
- Legal: need a short MOU for co-sell revenue share and lead routing — I've asked legal to draft; expect first cut by 2/27.

Attachments: azure-metering-integration-notes.docx (notes + sample payloads)

Proposed near-term plan:
1) Submit AWS listing (metering evidence + SOC2) on 2/24 as planned. That will get us initial AWS co-sell tagging and allow us to start lead routing.
2) Parallel track: Vanessa to own Azure questionnaire and joint brief; Ben to work on adapter and legal MOU.

Happy to demo the webhook flow to CloudBridge on a short call.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Zhou <ethan@cloudbridge.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-24T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell kickoff: SKU mapping + billing cert needs

Thanks Ben — that all looks fine. A few notes from our side after reviewing attachments: 

- Azure: the callback adapter timeline is okay; we can accept a temporary manual usage import for first 30 days if that helps speed certification.
- DocuSign: I put a preliminary MOU template into DocuSign for signatures (link below). Can legal at Redwood review and comment?
- AWS submission: we received confirmation from AWS ops that if you upload the seller evidence and SOC2 summary today they will queue listing verification (turnaround ~3 business days).

DocuSign MOU: https://docusign.example/mtf-2312
AWS queue link: https://marketplace.partnerportal.aws/submit/req-7712

We aim to have co-sell tag active by 3/2 if AWS verification goes as expected.

Ethan
Ethan Zhou
Partner Lead, CloudBridge

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-28T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Next steps and prep for validation call with CloudBridge

Team — quick internal note after Ethan's update. AWS is queued (good). Actions and owners: 

- Ben: demo metering webhook to CloudBridge and provide a short README (target 3/2). If Azure needs manual import we'll prepare CSV template by 3/2.
- Vanessa: finish joint solution brief draft and secure marketing logo usage signoff by 3/3. Share a first draft in the Drive link.
- Marissa: upload SOC2 summary + redacted architecture diagram to the AWS portal by EOD 2/29.
- Legal: review DocuSign MOU and send comments to Ethan by 3/1 (I pinged legal already).

I'll schedule a 30-min validation call with CloudBridge for 3/3 10:00am PT to walk through the AWS queue, verify artifacts, and triage any marketplace feedback. Calendar invite incoming.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=drive-file-abc123 (SKU workbook), https://hubspot.example/deal/HD-2345 (deal record)

Thanks — let's keep this tight so we can get co-sell enabled quickly.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Redwood Inference
